scenes.caption: FITFLOW AI: the follow-up engine for fitness coaches (interactive prototype)
scenes.text: This is FITFLOW AI: an interactive product prototype of a follow-up engine for independent fitness coaches. The idea is simple: every lead followed up, every client kept.

scenes.caption: Capture, prioritise, follow up, retain (GSAP ScrollTrigger)
scenes.text: As you scroll, How it works pins in place and steps through the loop: capture every enquiry, prioritise who to message today, follow up with drafts that explain themselves, and catch clients before they drift.

scenes.caption: Each sequence step produces a draft that shows its reasoning
scenes.text: Here's the engine. A new enquiry goes into a four-step sequence. Each step produces a draft for a real sample lead, with the parts written for them highlighted, and the reasons and checks beside it.

scenes.caption: Today: who to message and why, most urgent first
scenes.text: In the app, Today is the home screen. It ranks who to message: people who replied, due sequence steps, overdue leads and clients who are slipping. Every row says why it's there.

scenes.caption: The draft explains itself. The coach edits it and sends it themselves.
scenes.text: Opening a step drafts the message. FITFLOW shows what it used, like the lead's own words and the program they asked about, and which checks it passed. The coach edits it, sends it themselves, and logs the step.

scenes.caption: A reply pauses the sequence and moves them to the top
scenes.text: When someone replies, one click pauses their sequence, so the next message is a personal one rather than the next automated step.

scenes.caption: Sequences: cadences for new enquiries, proposals, quiet leads and client rescue
scenes.text: Sequences are the cadences behind it: new enquiries, proposals, quiet leads, and a client rescue sequence. Nothing is ever sent automatically.

scenes.caption: Retention: check-ins flag clients who are slipping
scenes.text: Weekly check-ins flag clients whose adherence is dropping. From here the coach can draft a check-in or start the rescue sequence.

scenes.caption: Every screen works in light and dark
scenes.text: And all of it works in dark mode too.

scenes.caption: Case study, Figma file and code: links in the description
scenes.text: The case study covers the problem, the decision to focus on follow-up, and the trade-offs. The live demo, the Figma file and the code are all linked in the description.
